origin: Embedded base-colour label of docs/BWC/Ultra_White_Plush_Creature_Cinema2.glb (ZERO SUGAR / claw emblem / ULTRA WHITE wordmark on off-white fleece), supplied by the project owner; extracted at 2048 px and converted to WebP, the 1024 px file is a lanczos downscale. Wrapped around the creature body as u = 0.5 + atan2(x, z) / 2π, v = 1.08453 - 0.35971 y (the GLB's own UV mapping).
